About the Company

Aggreko Australia Pty Ltd (Aggreko Australia) is a provider of flexible power generation solutions in Australia and the Pacific. It maintains global leadership in the temporary power generation marketplace by offering innovative rental solutions. Aggreko is a major player in the global power market. Aggreko has an established record of working with businesses to improve their outputs, manage power demands and plan for emergencies. Our specialised technology is critical to the operations of several global businesses, and we have continued to rapidly grow across the mining, construction and emergency service sector.

Position Description

We are seeking a dedicated Service Technician- Electrical to join our team on a full-time basis. In this role you will be responsible for the following:

Perform comprehensive maintenance on hire fleet assets.
Conduct scheduled servicing for optimal fleet performance.
Execute internal repairs, customer site installations/removals.
Troubleshoot issues to minimize downtime and costs.
Ensure fleet livery adheres to company policy and customer expectations.
Maintain adequate material and tool levels.
Maintain basic tooling and stock in service vehicle.
Quality and Customer Service:
Deliver quality workmanship to enhance equipment reliability.
Ensure customer satisfaction with equipment and service.
Maintain and enhance relationships with internal and external customers.
Provide technical support to the Sales Team.
Administrative and Operational:
Carry out electrical repairs and checks per company policy.
Accurately complete required documentation (Prep for Hire/Delivery/Return/Service Order FSL and Spartan Systems).
Manage work hours and complete tasks within deadlines, including potential overtime.
About You

To be successful in obtaining this role, you will have:

Proven experience in a similar role
Relevant trade qualification
Exceptional communication skills.
Strong customer focus.
Ability to work under pressure and make deadlines.
Planning, problem solving and coordination skills.
Ability to work unsupervised at times.
Salary

If successful, you will be paid a base salary of approximately $100,000 per annum.

Intura has a full range of capabilities and services for the energy and resource sectors. These services cover the full asset lifecycle from construction, start-up to decommissioning.

At Intura, our leadership team has over 150 years of combined experience across a broad technical and industry base. With a strong focus on developing our team’s capabilities, we’re committed to delivering lasting value to our clients. This approach has resulted significant growth and doubling of our client base in the last year.

Intura is seeking qualified and experienced Calibration Technician to join our team of professionals in Chinchilla QLD

Key responsibilities include performing calibrations according to specific procedures, troubleshooting instrument issues, maintaining detailed records of all activities, and working with various electronic and mechanical equipment.

Job duties include but will not be limited to:
Performing routine equipment maintenance
Calibrating equipment to industry standards
Troubleshooting equipment failures
Conducting equipment repairs
Responding to client queries
Suggesting equipment upgrades
Maintaining calibration equipment and supplies
Completing job cards and equipment reports

Qualifications, Key Skills, and Attributes:
Technical Expertise: Knowledge of industry calibration standards and proficiency with measuring equipment and specialised software
Hands-On Skills: Strong practical skills for working with intricate machinery and performing adjustments
Attention to Detail: A meticulous approach to conducting tests, recording data, and ensuring accuracy
Problem-Solving: The ability to quickly identify and resolve issues with instruments and equipment
Analytical Skills: Capability to analyse readings, assess equipment performance, and suggest improvements
Communication Skills: Clear oral and written communication for documenting work and interacting with colleagues and management.

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then please apply now!
Salary: $85,000 per annum

(residential homes, commercial buildings, and public spaces) across Sydney in Australia. On a full-time basis, you will
be part of a multidisciplinary and well-supported team.

Title: Painting Trades Worker, Full- time position
Salary: A$ 90,000.00 to 98,000.00 plus super
Work Location: In person.

We are looking for applicants who demonstrate the following:

Requirements
• Certificate 4 in painting and Decorating.
• Proven experience as a Painting Trades Worker for at least 2 years.
• Knowledge of technical skills and attention to detail.
• Attention to detail and precision.
• Good communication and teamwork skills.
• Excellent problem-solving abilities.

Responsibilities
• Surface Preparation: Knowledge of techniques to clean, sand, and prime surfaces before painting.
• Application Techniques: Proficiency in applying different types of paint, varnish, and coatings using brushes, rollers,
and spray guns.
• Colour Mixing: Ability to mix and match paint colours to achieve the desired shades and finishes.
• Tool Maintenance: Understanding of how to maintain and store painting tools and equipment.
• Lift and Carry Equipment: Ability to lift and carry heavy paint containers, ladders, and other equipment.
• Dexterity: Fine motor skills for precise painting and detail work.
• Quality Control: Ensuring that paint is applied evenly and surfaces are free from imperfections.
• Finish Work: Attending to the finishing touches that enhance the overall appearance of the painted surfaces.
• Protective Gear: Using masks, gloves, and other protective equipment to prevent exposure to harmful chemicals.
• Work Environment: Ensuring proper ventilation and handling of hazardous materials.
• Regulations: Adhering to safety standards and regulations set by occupational safety authorities.
• Cleaning equipment and work area


If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to date CV. We can schedule in
a time to discuss the positions available and what will be best suited to you.
